1. Initialize with metal units
2. Create a copper FCC lattice
3. Use the Cu_Zhou04.eam.alloy potential
4. Perform NPT relaxation at 300K and 0 pressure for 10000 steps
Action: write_file
Action Input: {"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/react/quenching/brief/subtasks/copper_npt_relaxation_subtask_quenching_trial_4/in.relax", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for Copper NPT relaxation

units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Create copper FCC lattice
lattice fcc 3.615  # Copper lattice constant in Angstroms
region box block 0 5 0 5 0 5
create_box 1 box
create_atoms 1 box

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Cu_Zhou04.eam.alloy Cu

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-6 1.0e-8 1000 10000

# Set mass for copper
mass 1 63.546

# Define compute for density
compute density all property/atom mass
compute sum_mass all reduce sum c_density
variable volume equal vol
variable density equal c_sum_mass/(v_volume*6.022e23)*10.0

# Initialize velocity
velocity all create 300 12345

# NPT relaxation
fix 1 all npt temp 300 300 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0
timestep 0.001

# Output density
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press density

# Run NPT
run 10000

# Write final structure
write_data /results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/react/quenching/brief/subtasks/copper_npt_relaxation_subtask_quenching_trial_4/relaxed.data

# Print final density
print "Final_density: ${density}""}
